dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For dimension n, this is the type of norm packages constructed by D011: a vector norm and a matrix norm satisfying positivity, definiteness, triangle, homogeneity, absolute-value invariance, componentwise monotonicity, basis normalization, subordination, and minimality of the matrix norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The chosen package supplies the matrix norm used to define the condition quantity and the scalar c8 in the smallness hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For dimension n, this is the type of complete computational-run packages constructed by D017, containing the precision, rounding models, matrices, vectors, solves, residual computations, iterates, and correction sequence together with their stated laws.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Almost every quantity in the proposition, including u, A, Ainv, b, the exact solution, iterates, corrections, and constants derived from them, is selected from this package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the third field of a run package, namely its real unit roundoff u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is a multiplicative factor in the smallness assumption c8*u*kappa <= 1/2 and in the bound's defining matrices and vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given a run and norm package, this is the type of auxiliary-constant packages constructed by D018, containing matrices C2 and C6 through C12, scalars c1, c5, c8, and resolvent inverses satisfying explicit equations and nonnegativity conditions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies c8 for the smallness condition and C8, C10, C11, and C12 for the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 11 of the constants package, the scalar c8, which D018 requires to equal the selected matrix norm of the matrix C8.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target assumes c8*u*|| |A||Ainv| ||_M <= 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the proposition packaging the two prior estimates supplied by D019: a conditional componentwise bound on the exact post-correction residual and an unconditional componentwise relation between the next iterate's error and that residual.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A proof of this proposition is an explicit hypothesis used together with the stronger c8 smallness condition to obtain the stated closed-form residual bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For iteration m, this is the vector r_m = A(x_m-d_m)-b, where x_m is run.iterate m and d_m is run.correction m; all operations in this definition are exact real matrix-vector arithmetic.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its componentwise absolute value is the left-hand side of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is kappa = || |A| |Ainv| ||_M, where absolute values are entrywise, juxtaposition is matrix multiplication, and ||.||_M is the matrix norm from the norm package.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the smallness assumption multiplied by c8 and u.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: At iteration m this is the vector B^m q+s, where B=u C8(|A||Ainv|), q=u(C10|A|)|x*|, and s=n*ubar |A||x*| + u^2(C11|A|)|x*| + ubar*u(C12(|A||Ainv|)|A|)|x*|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its ith component is the right-hand side of the final componentwise inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the second functional from a norm package, namely its matrix norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It evaluates the condition quantity kappa and the norm defining c8.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a norm package from vector and matrix functionals. The vector functional is nonnegative, vanishes exactly on the zero vector, satisfies triangle and absolute homogeneity, is invariant under entrywise absolute value, is monotone under componentwise absolute-value domination, and assigns norm 1 to every coordinate basis vector. The matrix functional is nonnegative, bounds ||Ax|| by ||A||_M||x||, and is no larger than every nonnegative constant having that subordinate-bound property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These axioms make the matrix norm in kappa and c8 a normalized induced norm with the monotonicity properties required by the packaged estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 12 of a run package, the n by n real matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A defines the exact residual, the condition matrix, all solve equations, and many auxiliary constants.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 13 of a run package, the n by n real matrix Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires it to be a two-sided inverse of A, and its entrywise absolute value enters kappa and the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 16 of a run package, the right-hand-side vector b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is subtracted in the exact residual r_m=A(x_m-d_m)-b and is used in the residual computations and exact system Ax*=b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 24 of a run package, the correction sequence d_m indexed by natural iterations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exact post-correction residual uses x_m-d_m.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 22 of a run package, the iterate sequence x_m indexed by natural iterations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters the exact residual, the prior error estimates, and the construction of computed residuals and corrections.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a run package. It requires n>0, u>0, n*u<=1/100, a working rounding model with unit roundoff u, a residual model with unit roundoff ubar, a conversion function with relative error at most u, exact two-sided inverse identities for A and Ainv, Ax*=b, entrywise nonnegative C1, backward-stable initial and correction solves, the stated initial values, modeled residual traces, and componentwise rounded updates x_(m+1)=flSub(x_m,d_m).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It encodes all structural and numerical assumptions silently carried by the universally quantified run argument.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs the constants package. With H=|A||Ainv|, it requires two-sided inverses R2 of I-u C1 H and R11 of I-u C8 H; sets C2=R2 C1, c1=||C1||_M, c5=n+((alpha+beta)u^2)/ubar, C6=C2+(1+c5*ubar/u)(I+u C2H), C7=(n+alpha*u^2/ubar)C2, C8=(1+u)C6, c8=||C8||_M, C9=C6+alpha I, C10=C6+(n*ubar/u+alpha*u)I+ubar C7H, C11=R11C9, and C12=R11(n C8+C7). It also requires the corresponding fixed-point equations, entrywise nonnegativity of C2 and C6 through C12, and 0<=c1<=c8.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These equations determine every matrix and scalar occurring in the smallness assumption and closed-form bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs the prior-estimate proposition from two estimates. If c1*u*kappa<=1/2, then |r_m(i)| is bounded by u[C6|A||x_m-x*|]_i +(n*ubar+alpha*u^2)[|A||x*|]_i +ubar*u[C7(|A||Ainv|)|A||x*|]_i. Independently, |x_(m+1)(i)-x*(i)| <= (1+u)[|Ainv||r_m|]_i+u|x*(i)|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the one-step inequalities whose recurrence is summarized by B^m q+s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a matrix A to its entrywise absolute-value matrix |A|, with |A|_ij=|A_ij|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used throughout kappa, B, q, s, and the prior estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the vector q=u(C10|A|)|x*|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the initial vector multiplied by B^m in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the matrix B=u C8(|A||Ainv|).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its exact natural matrix power B^m propagates the recurrence in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the forcing vector s=n*ubar |A||x*| + u^2(C11|A|)|x*| + ubar*u(C12(|A||Ainv|)|A|)|x*|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is added without an iteration-dependent geometric sum in the stated right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary n by n matrix multiplication: (AB)_ij=sum_k A_ik B_kj over all k in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines all matrix products in kappa, the constants, B, q, and s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: This recursively defines the exact matrix power B^m, with B^0=I and B^(m+1)=B B^m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It produces the B^m factor in the final bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j over Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the residual and every matrix-vector expression in the estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise vector addition, (x+y)_i=x_i+y_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the propagated and forcing vectors in the right-hand side and appears in solve equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is componentwise vector subtraction, (x-y)_i=x_i-y_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines x_m-d_m, the exact residual, and iterate errors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a solve-result package for A, rhs, C1, and u, constructed by D060 from an output and backward-error vector satisfying an exact perturbed-system equation and a componentwise backward-error bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Such packages constrain the initial solution and every correction in the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 1 of a solve-result package, its output vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The initial output is x_1, and each correction d_m equals the output of its corresponding solve package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 19 of a run package, the entrywise nonnegative matrix C1 controlling solve backward errors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is c1 and it participates in the resolvent defining C2 and hence all later constants.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 17 of a run package, the exact solution vector x*.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires Ax*=b, and |x*| enters q, s, and prior estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 2 of a run package, its two-valued precision selector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the formulas for ubar, alpha, beta, and whether computed residuals undergo conversion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 6 of the constants package, the matrix C10.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in q=u(C10|A|)|x*|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 7 of the constants package, the matrix C11.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the u^2(C11|A|)|x*| term of s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 8 of the constants package, the matrix C12.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in the ubar*u(C12H|A|)|x*| term of s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 2 of the constants package, the matrix C6.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the prior residual estimate and determines C8, C9, and C10.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 3 of the constants package, the matrix C7.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the prior residual estimate and determines C10 and C12.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 4 of the constants package, the matrix C8=(1+u)C6.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm is c8, and B=u C8(|A||Ainv|).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is field 9 of the constants package, the scalar c1=||C1||_M.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the coefficient in the conditional smallness premise of the first prior estimate; 0<=c1<=c8 lets the target's c8 condition imply it.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a two-constructor precision type with constructors D062 and D061. Its eliminator treats D062 as the first or single branch and D061 as the second or double branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects all precision-dependent constants and residual-conversion behavior.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of scalar floating-point-operation models constructed by D063, containing a nonnegative unit roundoff and modeled addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division satisfying relative-error equations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A run contains working and residual models that govern its updates and computed residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 4 of a floating-point model, its modeled subtraction operation flSub.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the rounded iterate update and subtraction of b during residual computation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 1 of a floating-point model, its unit-roundoff scalar.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run equates the working value to u and the residual-model value to ubar.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a residual-computation trace package for a precision, residual model, conversion, A, b, and x. It records a rounded matrix-vector product, a modeled subtraction of b, and the precision-dependent output.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Run residual traces determine computedResidual_(m+1), which is used as the right-hand side for correction solves.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 3 of a residual-computation trace, its output vector.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires computedResidual_(m+1) to equal this output.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the nonnegative matrix-vector expression (|A||x|)_i=sum_j |A_ij||x_j|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in backward-error bounds and in the prior relation [|Ainv||r_m|]_i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a vector x to its componentwise absolute-value vector |x|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in norm axioms and throughout all componentwise majorants.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: For j in Fin n, this is the coordinate basis vector e_j, equal to 1 at j and 0 elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The norm package requires every coordinate basis vector to have vector norm 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the n by n identity matrix I, with entries 1 on the diagonal and 0 off the diagonal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs in inverse identities, resolvents, matrix powers at exponent zero, and constants formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines alpha. In precision D062, alpha=(1+u)((1+u)^n-1)/u^2-n/u. In precision D061, alpha=(1+u)(1+u^2)((1+u^2)^n-1)/u^2-n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Alpha enters c5, C7, C9, C10, and the prior forcing terms.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines beta: beta=0 in precision D062 and beta=1+u in precision D061.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Beta appears in c5 and thereby affects C6, C8, and the final recurrence matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is entrywise matrix addition, (A+B)_ij=A_ij+B_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines terms in the auxiliary matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: This asserts that a matrix is entrywise nonnegative: A_ij>=0 for every i and j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires C1 nonnegative, and the constants package requires C2 and C6 through C12 nonnegative, supporting componentwise majorization.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a dependent natural-number case splitter choosing a supplied zero case at 0 and a supplied successor case at k+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the base and successor equations of the matrix power used in the bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is scalar multiplication of a matrix: (aA)_ij=a A_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms all scaled matrices in the constants, resolvents, and B.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is entrywise matrix subtraction, (A-B)_ij=A_ij-B_ij.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the resolvent matrices I-u C1H and I-u C8H.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines ubar from the precision selector: ubar=u in precision D062 and ubar=u^2 in precision D061.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ubar is the residual-model unit roundoff and appears throughout the constants, prior estimates, and forcing vector s.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is scalar multiplication of a vector: (ax)_i=a x_i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms q, s, and other componentwise majorants.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a solve package from output y and backward error e satisfying Ay=rhs+e and |e_i|<=u[C1(|A||y|)]_i for every i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each initial or correction solve a componentwise backward-stable solve with an error witness dependent on that solve.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the second constructor of the precision type, called the double branch by the supplied eliminator argument names; it selects ubar=u^2, beta=1+u, the second alpha formula, and output conversion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Choosing it changes the constants and residual-computation path but not the quantified form of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the first constructor of the precision type, called the single branch by the supplied eliminator argument names; it selects ubar=u, beta=0, the first alpha formula, and no final residual conversion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Choosing it changes the constants and residual-computation path but not the quantified form of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a floating-point model with unit roundoff epsilon>=0 and operations satisfying flAdd(x,y)=(x+y)(1+delta), flSub(x,y)=(x-y)(1+delta), flMul(x,y)=xy(1+delta), and, for y!=0, flDiv(x,y)=(x/y)(1+delta), with a separately existential delta satisfying |delta|<=epsilon for every operation and input pair.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These relative-error assumptions constrain the working updates and every rounded operation used to compute residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a residual trace with roundedAx_i equal to the model-computed dot product of row i of A with x, beforeConversion_i=flSub(roundedAx_i,b_i), and output equal to beforeConversion in precision D062 or to convert(beforeConversion_i) componentwise in precision D061.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the precise computed-residual process whose outputs feed the correction solves.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef065
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the case eliminator for precision: it returns the first supplied branch for D062 and the second supplied branch for D061.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects ubar, alpha, beta, and residual output behavior.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef066
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the same two-case precision elimination operation expressed through the recursor, with a D062 branch and a D061 branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the precision-dependent definitions used by the proposition's packages.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef067
dependency_coverage.meaning: This computes a modeled row dot product by applying model.flMul to each A_ij and x_j and combining the products with the ordered modeled summation D071.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines roundedAx inside each residual-computation trace.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef068
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the dependent recursor for the two-constructor precision type, selecting a value for D062 or D061.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the low-level mechanism behind all precision case distinctions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef069
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 3 of a floating-point model, its modeled addition flAdd.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines products in modeled dot products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef070
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects field 5 of a floating-point model, its modeled multiplication flMul.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes each product A_ij*x_j in modeled dot products.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef071
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given flAdd and a vector of length n, this returns 0 for n=0, the sole entry for n=1, and for larger n left-associatively combines the first n entries recursively and the last entry using flAdd.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the summation order used in every modeled matrix-vector product of a residual trace.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef072
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that if n=0 then 0<n+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the index-validity proof for the one-entry branch of the modeled summation; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef073
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is dependent case analysis on a natural dimension together with a vector of that dimension, choosing either the zero-dimensional or successor-dimensional branch.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the dimension split in the modeled summation.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it supplies ordinary division, including the literal 1/2 and divisions in auxiliary constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural indices strictly less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Vectors have domain Fin n, matrices have two Fin n indices, and the conclusion is componentwise over i in Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous division operation selected by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real instances it denotes ordinary real division in 1/2 and all displayed formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real instances it denotes ordinary real multiplication, including c8*u*kappa.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the less-than-or-equal relation selected by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instance it gives every non-strict real inequality in the assumptions and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes the dimension n and every iteration m.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: For nonzero n, this proves that n+1 is at least two and hence supports a numeral instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied in elaborating the real numeral 2 in the threshold 1/2; it contributes no extra hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies a proof that every natural successor n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the numeral 2 and does not alter the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts a type's interpretation of a natural-number literal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 0, 1, 2, and other numerals appearing in the formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This derives interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the numerator 1 in 1/2 the ordinary real one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All scalar, vector-component, matrix-entry, norm, and bound values are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive-group structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports negation, subtraction, and the ordered-group definition of real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies real multiplication, inversion, division, and integer powers as a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the real division used in 1/2 and the auxiliary formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the standard order relation <= on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the smallness assumption and final inequality as ordinary real inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary multiplication on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all scalar products in the target and dependencies.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the canonical cast of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n as the real scalar n in conditions and constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the multiplicative identity 1 in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets occurrences of 1, including the threshold 1/2 and relative-error factors 1+delta.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies maximum and minimum operations for the real order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the additive group it defines ordinary real absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: In the real instance, abs(a)=max(a,-a), the ordinary absolute value |a|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is applied to the residual component in the conclusion and entrywise throughout the majorants.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary same-type division operation into an HDiv operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every elaborated real hDiv expression is ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary same-type multiplication operation into an HMul operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every elaborated real hMul expression is ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets any natural numeral known to be at least two through the target type's natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the real literal 2 in 1/2 as the real number two.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural literal n in Nat as n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals used in dimensions, iteration indices, and numeral elaboration.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It joins each existential relative-error witness's magnitude bound with its exact operation equation.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses exact inverse, solve, trace, update, projection, and defining equations in the packages.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits input-dependent relative-error witnesses for conversion and modeled arithmetic operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips Fin n with its finite enumeration of all n indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows matrix and vector products to sum over every finite index.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: This sums a function over a finite set using the additive commutative monoid operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms exact finite sums in matrix multiplication and matrix-vector multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For Fin n it makes each exact matrix or vector product sum over all indices 0 through n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous addition operation selected by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With real or natural instances it denotes ordinary addition in formulas and successor indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is exponentiation selected by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real powers such as u^2, (1+u)^n, and (1+u^2)^n.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous subtraction operation selected by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real subtraction in residuals, errors, and auxiliary formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical equivalence.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the norm definiteness axiom ||x||=0 if and only if x is the zero vector.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the strict-order relation selected by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses n>0, u>0, and finite-index bounds inside the run and Fin values.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it gives the exact powers occurring in alpha and ubar formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.below
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the nested dependent collection of values for all smaller natural indices used by course-of-values recursion.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides recursive predecessors for the matrix-power and modeled-summation definitions, without adding an assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.brecOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is course-of-values recursion on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements exact matrix powers and the dimension-recursive modeled sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a natural number to a type with a natural-cast structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it produces the scalar n used in n*u, c5, C7, C10, and s.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps n to its successor n+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies iteration shifts and the recursive dimension cases.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is unary negation selected by a Neg instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it defines -b, -x_1, subtraction, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips a function type with the pointwise zero function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets x_0=0 and equalities asserting a vector is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary addition on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all scalar additions in matrix, vector, and constant formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive commutative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports finite real sums in exact matrix and matrix-vector products.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the standard strict order < on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the run condition u>0.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports exact natural powers in the precision-dependent constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary negation on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets negative vectors and real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies real subtraction as addition of the negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets residuals, errors, resolvent matrices, and differences in alpha.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets zero vectors, nonnegativity, identity off-diagonal entries, and empty sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Unit
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is a one-element type used for branches that require no substantive input.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is administrative data in case eliminators and contributes no mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: This derives interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real and functional zeros in all package equations.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m+1, n+1, and related index arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary same-type addition operation into an HAdd operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes elaborated real and natural hAdd expressions ordinary addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary power operation into an HPow operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes elaborated real powers ordinary natural exponentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This converts an ordinary same-type subtraction operation into an HSub operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes elaborated real hSub expressions ordinary subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n>0 and the bounds carried by Fin indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.casesOn
dependency_coverage.meaning: This performs case analysis on a natural number, selecting a zero case or successor case.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements helper case distinctions for powers and modeled summation.

dependency_coverage.name: Unit.unit
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the unique inhabitant of Unit.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the dummy argument to zero and precision branches and has no mathematical effect.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: This decides equality between two Fin n indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the diagonal tests in identity matrices and coordinate basis vectors computable.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary if-then-else selected by a decidable proposition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines identity-matrix and coordinate-basis entries as 1 when indices agree and 0 otherwise.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines a!=b as the negation of a=b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the nonzero-denominator restriction in the modeled division error law.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This embeds an index in Fin n into the corresponding initial index of Fin (n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It lets the recursive modeled sum access the first n entries of an (n+1)-entry vector.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.last
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the final index n in Fin (n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the last term added by the recursive modeled sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a Fin n value from a natural value together with a proof that it is less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs the sole index used in the one-entry modeled-sum case.

dependency_coverage.name: Not
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines logical negation as implication to false.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies non-equality assumptions and the false branch of dependent conditionals.

dependency_coverage.name: dite
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is dependent if-then-else, whose selected value may depend on a proof of the condition or its negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the n=0 versus n!=0 branch in the successor case of modeled summation.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This decides equality of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It decides whether the predecessor dimension is zero in the modeled-summation definition.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.zero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the natural number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the base dimension, base iteration, and base exponent used throughout the definitions.

binders: n is an implicitly quantified natural-number dimension.

run is an arbitrary n-dimensional computational-run package; write A for run.A, Ainv for run.Ainv, b for run.b, x* for run.exactSolution, u for run.u, x_m for run.iterate m, and d_m for run.correction m.
norm is an arbitrary n-dimensional norm package associated with the run; write ||.||_v for its vector norm and ||.||_M for its matrix norm.
constants is an arbitrary auxiliary-constant package associated with run and norm, containing C2, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10, C11, C12 and scalars c1, c5, c8.
prior is a proof of the packaged prior estimates described below.
The conclusion universally quantifies m over all natural numbers and i over Fin n.
hypotheses: The norm package satisfies: ||x||_v>=0; ||x||_v=0 iff x=0; ||x+y||_v<=||x||_v+||y||_v; ||a x||_v=|a| ||x||_v; || |x| ||_v=||x||_v; componentwise |x_i|<=|y_i| implies ||x||_v<=||y||_v; ||e_j||_v=1; ||M||_M>=0; ||Mx||_v<=||M||_M||x||_v; and if c>=0 bounds ||Mx||_v by c||x||_v for every x, then ||M||_M<=c.

The run package entails n>0, u>0, and n*u<=1/100. Its working arithmetic model has unit roundoff u. Its residual arithmetic model has unit roundoff ubar, where ubar=u in precision D062 and ubar=u^2 in precision D061.

Every modeled scalar addition, subtraction, and multiplication has the exact result multiplied by 1+delta for some input-dependent delta with |delta| bounded by that model's unit roundoff; modeled division has the analogous property for nonzero denominators. For every real y, convert(y)=y(1+delta) for some y-dependent delta with |delta|<=u.
Ainv*A=I and A*Ainv=I exactly, and A*x*=b exactly. The matrix C1 is entrywise nonnegative.
The initial solve carries a backward-error vector e_init such that A*x_1=b+e_init and |e_init_i|<=u[C1(|A||x_1|)]_i. Also x_0=0, computedResidual_0=-b, and d_0=-x_1.

For each m, computedResidual_(m+1) is the output of a modeled residual trace for A*x_(m+1)-b: each row product is computed using modeled multiplications and a fixed left-associated modeled summation, b is subtracted with modeled subtraction, and the result is either retained in precision D062 or converted componentwise in precision D061.

For each m, d_m is the output of a solve carrying a backward-error vector e_m such that A*d_m=computedResidual_m+e_m and |e_m(i)|<=u[C1(|A||d_m|)]_i. The update satisfies x_(m+1)(i)=workingModel.flSub(x_m(i),d_m(i)) for every i.
Let alpha=(1+u)((1+u)^n-1)/u^2-n/u and beta=0 in precision D062. Let alpha=(1+u)(1+u^2)((1+u^2)^n-1)/u^2-n and beta=1+u in precision D061.

With H=|A||Ainv|, the constants package contains two-sided inverses R2 of I-u C1H and R11 of I-u C8H, and satisfies C2=R2C1, c1=||C1||_M, c5=n+((alpha+beta)u^2)/ubar, C6=C2+(1+c5*ubar/u)(I+u C2H), C7=(n+alpha*u^2/ubar)C2, C8=(1+u)C6, c8=||C8||_M, C9=C6+alpha I, C10=C6+(n*ubar/u+alpha*u)I+ubar C7H, C11=R11C9, and C12=R11(n C8+C7).
The constants additionally satisfy C11=C9+(u C8H)C11 and C12=(n C8+C7)+(u C8H)C12; C2 and C6 through C12 are entrywise nonnegative; and 0<=c1<=c8.

Writing r_m=A(x_m-d_m)-b and kappa=||H||_M, prior supplies the following implication: if c1*u*kappa<=1/2, then for every m and i, |r_m(i)|<=u[C6|A||x_m-x*|]_i+(n*ubar+alpha*u^2)[|A||x*|]_i+ubar*u[C7H|A||x*|]_i.
Prior also supplies, for every m and i, |x_(m+1)(i)-x*(i)|<=(1+u)[|Ainv||r_m|]_i+u|x*(i)|.
The explicit smallness hypothesis is c8*u*kappa<=1/2.
conclusions: For every natural iteration m and every i in Fin n, |[A(x_m-d_m)-b]_i| <= [B^m q+s]_i, where B=u C8H, q=u(C10|A|)|x*|, and s=n*ubar |A||x*|+u^2(C11|A|)|x*|+ubar*u(C12H|A|)|x*|.
mathematical_definitions: Fin n is the index set {0,...,n-1}; vectors are functions Fin n -> Real and matrices are functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
For vectors and matrices, absolute-value bars denote entrywise real absolute value. Vector addition, subtraction, and scalar multiplication are componentwise.
Matrix multiplication and matrix-vector multiplication are the exact finite sums (MN)_ij=sum_k M_ik N_kj and (Mx)_i=sum_j M_ij x_j.
I is the identity matrix. B^0=I and B^(m+1)=B B^m, so B^m is an exact matrix power.
r_m=A(x_m-d_m)-b is an exact-real residual of the exact subtraction x_m-d_m, not the separately stored computedResidual_m.
The right-hand side LocalDef009(constants,m,i) is exactly the ith component of B^m q+s.
The numeral 1/2 is ordinary real division and hence equals one half.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible positive-dimensional run, every admissible induced norm package, and every auxiliary-constant package satisfying the displayed resolvent equations, nonnegativity properties, and norm relations, assume the two packaged prior estimates. If the stronger smallness condition c8*u*|| |A||Ainv| ||_M <= 1/2 holds, then at every natural iteration m and every component i, the exact residual of the exact post-correction vector x_m-d_m is bounded in absolute value by the ith component of B^m q+s, with B, q, and s defined exactly above.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although n is universally quantified over all naturals, every run package carries a proof n>0. Thus no run can be constructed at n=0 from the supplied constructor; independently, Fin 0 would make the componentwise conclusion empty.

The theorem does not assert existence of a run, norm package, constants package, or prior-estimate proof. It is conditional and therefore vacuous for parameters for which any required package is uninhabited.
The implication is also vacuous when the explicit c8 smallness assumption is false.

The first estimate inside prior is itself conditional on c1*u*kappa<=1/2. Under a valid constants package and run, 0<=c1<=c8 and u*kappa>=0, so the target's c8 smallness condition implies that premise.
All conclusions are componentwise and hold for every natural m, including m=0. No convergence, decay of B^m, spectral-radius bound, limiting result, or normwise residual estimate is stated.
The bounded quantity is the exact-real vector A(x_m-d_m)-b. It is not directly the stored computed residual, nor necessarily A*x_(m+1)-b because x_(m+1) is obtained by modeled subtraction.

All matrix products, powers, and expressions in the final bound are exact real computations. Only operations explicitly stored in the working and residual models, and the conversion function, carry relative-error witnesses.
Relative-error deltas and solve backward-error vectors may depend on their respective inputs, operation calls, iterations, and solves; no single uniform witness is asserted.
The rounding model encodes only multiplicative relative-error equations. It does not encode overflow, underflow, subnormal behavior, exceptional values, or a concrete hardware format.
The precision type has only two abstract constructors. No bit widths, radix, or external identification of those constructors is encoded.
The matrices A and Ainv must be exact two-sided inverses, and x* must solve Ax*=b exactly. The resolvent matrices I-u C1H and I-u C8H must also possess explicitly supplied exact two-sided inverses.

Lean's real division is total even at zero, but constructed runs have u>0 and the two precision branches give ubar>0, so the divisions by u and ubar in the displayed constants have nonzero denominators.
The selected matrix norm is abstract: it is characterized by the supplied induced-norm axioms but is not identified as a particular standard norm such as the 1-, 2-, or infinity norm.
The proposition asserts only an upper bound. It does not assert nontriviality, sharpness, equality, or optimality of B^m q+s.
ambiguities: The precision constructors have no intrinsic human-facing names in the dossier. Calling D062 the single branch and D061 the double branch follows only the argument labels of the supplied eliminator; their exact branch formulas are nevertheless unambiguous.

Names such as iterate, correction, residual, and exactSolution suggest an algorithmic interpretation, but the translation relies only on the explicit constructor equations. In particular, no unstated sign convention or application-specific meaning is assumed.
